title: CLTR Cutover ConcurrencyConflict record
description: Phase 136R, Implementation Group 8 (CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 v1.0 Sec.27, Sec.46). A ConcurrencyConflict document describes a claimed concurrent-writer or CAS-mismatch conflict among two or more actors contending over one or more CutoverRequest records; it never itself resolves a conflict, selects a winner, performs a compare-and-swap, retries publication, mutates an authority pointer, establishes current authority, or proves that a conflict actually occurred (Sec.1, Sec.40). Legacy lifecycle remains the sole production authority; CLTR remains derivative. Tier 2 (_extensions only, Sec.14). authority_role 'authoritative' is locally forbidden (Sec.9's 12-file list includes concurrency_conflict). ConcurrencyConflict and RecoveryJournalEntry are contract Group 8 (Sec.46), paired atomically per CSCH-EXEC-REQ-062 -- neither may be implemented without the other in the same governed phase; this schema and recovery_journal_entry.schema.json are introduced together in this same commit. Not in the phase_id-required or transition_id-required family lists (Sec.7.2), so neither field is declared here. winner is declared required-and-nullable, not conditionally absent -- the one deliberate exception to Sec.7.4's general absent-preferred rule (Sec.27): every conflict record must take an explicit position (a reference, or null for 'not yet known') on whether a winner is known.

schema_id.description: Always present. Identifies this document as validated against the ConcurrencyConflict schema.

schema_version.description: Always present. This file's own MAJOR.MINOR version.

contract_version.description: Always present. CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 version this schema was generated against.

record_type.description: Always present. Fixed family tag for this record type.

record_id.description: Always present. Shape-checked only; never recomputed at Layer 2.

record_digest.description: Always present. Digest of this document itself. Shape-checked only; never recomputed at Layer 2.

created_at.description: Always present. Never used to establish record identity or ordering across documents.

migration_epoch.description: Always present. Every companion record binds to exactly one migration epoch (Sec.7.2, CSCH-INV-1). concurrency_conflict is not in the phase_id-required or transition_id-required family lists (Sec.7.2).

actors.description: Always present (Sec.27). At least 2 entries, each either an opaque non-secret principal identifier (a human/service actor) or a record_reference (a companion-record actor, e.g. a competing publication attempt). A schema-valid actors array never itself proves those actors actually contended for the same resource (Layer 4).

requests.description: Always present (Sec.27). At least 1 entry, each a family-tagged reference to the CutoverRequest(s) this conflict concerns. A valid reference never implies the referenced request exists or matches (Layer 4).

expected_state.description: Conditionally present: required, together with observed_state, only when type is 'cas_mismatch' (Sec.16); omitted (never null) otherwise, per Sec.7.4's absent-versus-null contract. Sec.27 does not name a specific family restriction for this reference, so no record_family const is applied here -- disclosed as NON-BLOCKING-136R-3, consistent with the precedent of not inventing an unfrozen family restriction (cf. cutover_candidate.schema.json's stage2_generation_reference, NON-BLOCKING-136N-7).

observed_state.description: Conditionally present: required, together with expected_state, only when type is 'cas_mismatch' (Sec.16); omitted (never null) otherwise. Same family-restriction disclosure as expected_state (NON-BLOCKING-136R-3).

type.description: Always present. Record-local ConflictType (Sec.8.8, 4 values), home schema this file per Sec.8.8's specific per-family table (favored here over Sec.6's looser shared-defs summary row, matching prior groups' specific-over-summary precedent, e.g. 136N's NON-BLOCKING-136N-2). 'cas_mismatch' requires expected_state and observed_state (enforced below); a schema-valid type value never itself proves the conflict was correctly classified (Layer 4).

winner.description: Always present as a key (Sec.27 winner-unknown rule, the one deliberate exception to Sec.7.4's general absent-preferred rule) -- null when no winner is known, a record_reference otherwise. A schema-valid non-null winner never itself proves that reference is the actual, correctly-resolved winner (Layer 4/6).

recovery_requirement.description: Always present (Sec.27). Shared RecoveryState (Sec.8.6, 10 values, already implemented at 136H). A schema-valid value here never itself proves recovery occurred, is required, or is safe (Layer 4/6) -- it is a structural classification only.

authority_disclosure.description: Always present. authority_role 'authoritative' is locally forbidden on this record (Sec.9's 12-file list); is_authoritative remains const false per the shared definition regardless. A valid ConcurrencyConflict record never itself proves a conflict occurred, was correctly classified, or was resolved.

_extensions.description: Conditionally present: the single reserved Tier 2 extension key (Sec.14). String-valued map only, no nested arbitrary structure. Forward-compatible annotation only; never authority-bearing, never interpreted as conflict resolution.

request_reference.description: A record_reference locally restricted to record_family 'cutover_request', with schema_id/schema_version unconditionally required (Sec.12 cross-family rule).
